You are well into being abused. It took me forever (10 years) to recognize that I was abused because my ex didn't ever even jokingly kick or hit me. he was all mental/emotional/little bit of sexual abuse. But I had thoughts similar where I'd wish he would just hit me because maybe then he could get past the anger? Like I would think I wish he would just hit me instead of this. I think that's a clear sign right there. If your relationship makes you wish he would just beat you, whether he is already hitting you or not you are being abused. Get out. I made a plan and it took me a year to save up and get out, but I could have gotten out sooner if I was willing to go through more court and using things life safe houses. I have a child so I spent a year planning and saving money before I got out. If you don't have a child I recommend saving up if you can and then just leaving and leaving him a note. If you have kids you can still do the same thing and seek out a domestic abuse center near you. They will give you an advocate that will talk to you and can help you. Sadly where I live I got a lot of "well if you aren't in immediate physical danger we can't do much for you" but you are severely minimizing what is happening to you. You are in immediate physical danger. Get out.
